summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of the 3 NEW modules (Seller Support, Weight Discrepancies, Return Orders) plus auth/branding/marketplaces/masters. 21/21 backend pytest cases pass. Full UI end-to-end flow passes: ticket create/reply(agent->awaiting_seller, seller->responded)/resolve; weight create/edit/status change/save; raise-ticket sets status=disputed and disables button; return create with problem status auto-creates SAH-* ticket; patching normal return to qc_failed auto-creates ticket; scan sales works; issues-only filter works; MarketplaceSelector shows Myntra active + Amazon/Flipkart/... as (soon). Cross-module tickets appear in Seller Support with correct category filters (weight, return). Branding fully rebranded (Story At Home / SAH monogram / Powered by fundle, no Latin Quarter anywhere). All 17 sidebar pages render without crash on clean-seeded empty data.
critical_code_review_comments: seller_support.create_ticket inserts using `dict(ticket)` (fine) but returns _clean(ticket) — good practice, kept.

returns._auto_ticket mutates doc via update_one but the in-memory `doc` in create_return already has stale ticket_id=None before merge — resolved by explicit reassignment after _auto_ticket. Consistent.
weight.raise_ticket rejects when a ticket already linked (400) — matches UI (button disabled). Good.

No auth guard (Depends(require_admin)) on POST /support/tickets, POST /weight/discrepancies, POST /returns, POST /support/tickets/{id}/messages, POST /weight/.../raise-ticket, POST /returns/{id}/create-ticket, PATCH endpoints. Only DELETE endpoints and /returns/scan enforce admin. If viewer role should be read-only, add require_admin to mutating routes. (Not blocking — request did not specify RBAC for new modules.)

returns.scan uses fields nsv_val/report_month from sales collection. On clean seed the sales collection is empty so it returns {created:0, skipped:0} — verified. If sales schema evolves these fields should be validated.

Frontend WeightRow / ReturnRow store local editable state derived from props at mount only; after global load() refresh the derived variance columns update from server-echoed row, but the local `cw/ew/status` in WeightRow may go stale if the row is re-rendered from a new list without remount. Consider keying on `${w.id}-${w.updated_at}` for perfect sync (minor).
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed tickets, weight discrepancies (UI-WT-*, TEST-SKU-1), and return orders (TEST-RET-1/2) via API + UI. No teardown fixtures — these persist in MongoDB for further testing; they follow TEST_/UI-* naming so they are easy to purge later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sah_new_modules.py covers all new-module endpoints + cross-module ticket linkage. Run non-parallel (`pytest -p no:xdist -o addopts=""`) to avoid ordering issues in the cross-module assertion (Weight ticket must be raised before it's queried under support?category=weight). DB is now polluted with a few TEST_/UI-* rows in support_tickets, weight_discrepancies, return_orders — behaves like normal data and won't break other tests.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only one internal test-suite quirk: with pytest-xdist LoadScope split, TestReturns.test_cross_module_ticket_visible could run on a different worker before TestWeight.test_raise_ticket completes, causing spurious 0-vs-1 count. Ran with -p no:xdist -> all 21 pass. Not an app bug.
